about: I am a full-stack developer in Quebec focused on products that survive real production use: clear boundaries, object-oriented design, typed data, and proof through tests.

My day-to-day work spans .NET/C#, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, authentication, integrations, background processing, Docker, and CI/CD. I enjoy the point where product needs, data quality, and engineering reliability meet.
I am extending that practice to mobile development with React Native and Expo while keeping the same standards for maintainability, user experience, and incremental delivery.

I use AI as a practical lever to understand systems, automate repetitive work, and improve quality without replacing engineering judgment. Code review, automated testing, collaboration, and continuous learning remain central to how I work.
